title: Accounts Receivable Standing Rules: Stratton Bay License Administration Fee on Microsoft 365 Subscriptions
content:
Stratton Bay charges its own license administration fee on Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) subscriptions. This fee is separate from the Microsoft license price.

## Rules

**1. Former invoicing clause, no longer in force.** This clause is no longer in force as written: "On the first day of each calendar month the license administration fee for the previous month is invoiced on every subscription whose status was active or suspended at the end of that month: the plan's administration fee per license times the licenses held at the end of that month, rounded half up to the cent."

The fee for the previous month is still invoiced on the first day of each calendar month, on every subscription whose status was active or suspended at the end of that month. It is now worked out under the administration fee schedule, from the licenses the subscription carries when the fee posts.

**2. Former waiver clause, no longer in force.** This clause is no longer in force as written: "Where the plan's fee is subject to waiver for ClearPath clients, no fee is posted for a month in which the client held a ClearPath agreement whose status was active or notice given on the last day of the month and whose tier includes Microsoft 365 administration; a ClearPath Monitor agreement does not waive the fee."

Where the plan's fee is subject to that waiver, the share of the fee charged now follows the client's ClearPath coverage as it stands on the day the fee posts, which Stratton Bay takes for the month just ended. That share is set in the administration fee schedule.

**3. Ended subscriptions (in force).** Expired and cancelled subscriptions carry no fee for the months after they ended.

## Points of judgement

| Subscription at the end of the month | Fee for that month invoiced on the first of the next month? |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes, worked out under the administration fee schedule |
| Suspended | Yes, worked out under the administration fee schedule |
| Expired or cancelled in an earlier month | No fee for the months after it ended |

**Hypothetical dating.** The fee for the month of May is invoiced on 1 June, on a subscription that was active or suspended at the end of May.

superseded_clauses: On the first day of each calendar month the license administration fee for the previous month is invoiced on every subscription whose status was active or suspended at the end of that month: admin_fee_usd times license_qty at the end of that month, rounded half up to the cent.

Where admin_fee_waived_with_clearpath_admin is true, no fee is posted for a month in which the client held a ClearPath agreement whose status was active or notice_given on the last day of the month and whose tier has m365_administration_included true; a ClearPath Monitor agreement does not waive the fee.
